_note: Speak mode checker settings (DESIGN.md section 6 and 10). checkUrl is the Cloudflare Worker that holds the Azure key. If it cannot be reached, the game uses Chrome's recognizer. Score numbers are 0 to 100 from Azure Pronunciation Assessment; tune them from Test mode readouts.

passage._note: Read aloud for World 8 story cards and the Rift Seal (Session 14). wordMin: Azure word score that still counts an accented read as right (35 until Session 15, raised to 50 after Mr. Scott found mangled words passing). chromeRescue: let Chrome's follow-along rescue a word Azure called skipped (off since Session 15; Chrome fills in words from context). endQuietMs: pause after the last word that ends a sentence. stuckQuietMs: a long pause that moves on (the student can also press Next). clipMaxMs: Azure takes about 30 seconds per check. lineQuietMs: with no Chrome follow-along, this pause ends a sentence.
